news.title: Mythri Film Distributors Faces High-Stakes Month in Nizam
news.summary: Mythri Film Distributors is heavily investing in multiple upcoming big releases in the Nizam region following fierce bidding wars. With upcoming titles like AK47, Jailer 2, and Ranabaali lined up after mixed results for Peddi and The Paradise, the distributor faces a critical few weeks. However, the financial risk is distributed among multiple partners as they push to secure their market presence.

news.title: The Paradise Day 2 Box Office Holds Firm in Telangana Despite Drops
news.summary: Natural Star Nani's The Paradise raked in approximately Rs. 19 crores gross on its second day, driven by a solid performance in Telangana. While overseas markets and Andhra Pradesh witnessed significant drops following negative word-of-mouth, the strong Nizam hold prevented a complete box office crash. The makers are now banking on the weekend momentum to recover lost ground in overseas territories and AP.

news.title: Chiranjeevi's Playful Quip at Sigma Pre-Release Event Goes Viral
news.summary: Megastar Chiranjeevi brought his signature humor to the Hyderabad pre-release event of the upcoming film Sigma by addressing online trolling about blocking others' growth. Playfully questioning co-star Faria Abdullah about missing a dance opportunity in Vishwambhara, his lighthearted remarks quickly became a major talking point online. The action-adventure heist project, starring Sundeep Kishan and Faria Abdullah, marks the directorial debut of Jason Sanjay and is slated for an October 2, 2026 release.

news.title: Aadarsha Kutumbam Shifts Release Date as Special Song Promotion Nears
news.summary: The Venkatesh and Trivikram family entertainer Aadarsha Kutumbam has moved its theatrical release from October 2 to October 9. Ahead of the premiere, makers are set to release a high-profile promotional track featuring Srinidhi Shetty, Nivetha Pethuraj, Dimple Hayathi, and Venkatesh. Backed by Haarika & Hassine Creations, the big-ticket project features music composed by Thaman.

news.title: Nani and Team Address The Paradise Criticism Amid Decent Weekend Hold
news.summary: Actor Nani and director Srikanth Odela are openly facing the mixed reviews and social media trolling surrounding The Paradise rather than staying away from the media. Despite the negative talk, the film registered a career-best opening day for Nani with over ₹75 crore and avoided a total collapse on day two. The team is holding a press meet to address the criticism directly, with weekend collections in B and C centres crucial for crossing the ₹100 crore milestone.

news.title: Chiranjeevi Shares Excitement Ahead of Tamil Movie Sigma's Release
news.summary: Megastar Chiranjeevi attended the grand pre-release event of the upcoming Kollywood film Sigma as the chief guest. During the function, he expressed his eagerness to watch the movie, which is directed by Jason Vijay and stars Sundeep Kishan and Faria Abdullah. He also recalled his past association with the director's grandfather, S.A. Chandrasekhar, while extending his best wishes to the entire team.

news.title: Actress Preity Mukhundhan Cast Opposite Dhanush in D56
news.summary: Preity Mukhundhan has secured a major role as the female lead alongside Dhanush in his 56th film, tentatively titled D56. The project recently marked its official launch with a traditional pooja ceremony held at the Karuppanasamy Temple near Madurai. Directed by Tamizharasan Pachamuthu, the movie also features SJ Suryah and Vadivelu in prominent roles.

news.title: Nani's The Paradise Experiences Steep Overseas Decline on Day Two
news.summary: Actor Nani's latest movie, The Paradise, recorded an impressive career-best opening internationally by collecting $2.3 million on its first day. However, the film suffered a sharp drop on its second day, earning only $250K to bring its two-day offshore total to $2.55 million. The sudden deceleration follows immediate negative reports in the overseas theatrical circuit.

news.title: Megastar Chiranjeevi Gives Production Update on Upcoming Action Film Kaaka
news.summary: Chiranjeevi revealed fresh production updates regarding his action entertainer Kaaka, directed by Bobby. He stated that the first half of the shoot has concluded, alongside 30 percent of the second half, while dubbing work is simultaneously underway. The film features the actor as Kadiri Kalidas and remains on schedule for a theatrical release during Sankranti on January 13, 2027.

news.title: Keerthy Suresh Starrer Dorothy Sparks Polarized Reactions Over Queer Narrative
news.summary: Keerthy Suresh promoted her Tamil film Dorothy, directed by Karthik Subbaraj, at the Toronto International Film Festival prior to its theatrical release. The movie has since divided audiences and drawn considerable online debate over its second-half plot shift, queer theme, and climax. While some viewers and critics appreciated the feature, others strongly objected to its messaging and conclusion.

news.title: Vijay Deverakonda and Rashmika Mandanna Share Playful Online Chatter
news.summary: Actors Vijay Deverakonda and Rashmika Mandanna charmed fans with a lively social media interaction regarding a track from their upcoming film. Rashmika expressed her enduring admiration for Vijay, who responded with a warm note about her character and their future together. Directed by Rahul Sankrityan, their period action drama Ranabaali is slated to arrive in theaters worldwide on October 16, 2026.

news.title: Megastar Chiranjeevi Cleverly Addresses Online Trolls at Recent Event
news.summary: Megastar Chiranjeevi surprised audiences and internet critics alike by playfully poking fun at recent online memes targeting him during a pre-release function. Referencing the negative narrative circulating on social media, the veteran actor delivered a lighthearted self-deprecating joke about restricting others' growth. This witty reaction quickly drew widespread attention and became a major talking point across digital platforms.

news.title: Chiranjeevi Compares Sundeep Kishan's Drive to His Early Years
news.summary: Megastar Chiranjeevi attended the pre-release event for Sundeep Kishan's upcoming heist action drama Sigma as the chief guest. During the gathering, Chiranjeevi lauded the lead actor's penchant for unique scripts, noting it reminded him of his own early days in the industry. The film, directed by debutant Jason Sanjay and produced by Lyca Productions, is scheduled for release on October 2.

news.title: The Paradise Defies Negative Talk with Strong Global Collections
news.summary: Despite encountering predominantly negative initial reviews, Nani's latest starrer successfully averted a steep box office drop on its second day. Trade reports indicate that the project amassed a worldwide gross exceeding Rs. 20 crores on a regular working day. Industry observers note that while better word-of-mouth could have elevated results further, Nani's dependable star power helped sustain the momentum.

news.title: Vijay Deverakonda Unveils Striking Warrior Look for Pan-India Drama Ranabaali
news.summary: The creators of the period action drama Ranabaali have released a brand-new poster highlighting Vijay Deverakonda in an intense warrior role. Co-starring Rashmika Mandanna and directed by Rahul Sankrityan, the film draws inspiration from 19th-century historical events under British rule. Audiences worldwide can catch the movie in theaters when it arrives for Vijayadashami on October 16, 2026.

news.title: Jr NTR Set to Grace Pre-Release Event for Fahadh Faasil's Telugu Debut
news.summary: The upcoming Telugu film Don’t Trouble The Trouble is generating steady momentum as it prepares for its theatrical launch. Marking Fahadh Faasil's lead debut in Telugu cinema, the project is presented by SS Rajamouli and has caught attention with its intriguing trailer. Organizers are bringing in Jr NTR as the special chief guest for the pre-release event to boost visibility among fans.

news.title: Chiranjeevi Extends Major Support at Pre-Release Event for Sundeep Kishan's Sigma
news.summary: Megastar Chiranjeevi made a surprise appearance as the chief guest at the pre-release event for Sigma, which stars Sundeep Kishan and is directed by Jason Sanjay. Set for an October 2, 2026 release, the film has drawn considerable curiosity due to its young director and backing from Lyca Productions. Chiranjeevi praised the team's efforts, reminisced about his association with the director's family, and wished the project success.

news.title: Jailer 2 Opts for Melodic Tracks Ahead of Release
news.summary: With Jailer 2 set to arrive on October 15, 2026, director Nelson Dilipkumar and music composer Anirudh Ravichander have chosen to release softer numbers like Ala Bolelo and One Sun One Moon rather than an immediate mass anthem. This strategy has surprised some fans who anticipated a high-energy track celebrating Rajinikanth's presence right away. However, many believe the team is deliberately holding back bigger surprises as the premiere draws closer.

news.title: Actresses Step into Historical Roles for New Biopics
news.summary: A growing trend sees leading heroines stepping away from standard glamorous characters to tackle demanding biographical roles. Shraddha Kapoor has been cast as Marathi stage artist and Lavani dancer Vithabai Narayangaonkar, while Rashmika Mandanna takes on the legendary Carnatic singer M.S. Subbulakshmi. Meanwhile, Kiara Advani prepares to portray renowned actress Meena Kumari on screen.

news.title: Kalki 2898 AD Sequel Prepares for October Filming
news.summary: Following the massive success of the original blockbuster, the sequel to Kalki 2898 AD is scheduled to begin regular shooting in October under director Nag Ashwin. Produced by Ashwini Dutt's Vyjayanthi Movies, the upcoming film brings back Prabhas alongside prominent cast members Amitabh Bachchan and Kamal Haasan. The director aims to wrap up production by mid-2027 with a much larger scale and scope.

news.title: Karthik Subbaraj's Dorothy Sparks Debate Over LGBTQ Content
news.summary: Karthik Subbaraj's latest directorial venture, Dorothy, starring Keerthy Suresh, Sananth, and Rishikanth, has generated intense discussion following its theatrical release. Set against 1990s caste violence, the film has drawn both criticism and praise for its bold depiction of LGBTQ themes and intimate male scenes. Meanwhile, the director is gauging interest for a potential Telugu release following positive initial responses.

news.title: Nani's The Paradise Pulls Impressive Worldwide Opening Numbers
news.summary: Nani's latest movie, The Paradise, recorded a stellar global opening by pulling in roughly 75 crore gross and 44.53 crore share inclusive of premieres. While major urban centers like Hyderabad and regions like North America show solid traction, rural Nizam, Andhra, and Ceeded territories have displayed early drops. The film requires significant momentum to reach its 210-220 crore gross breakeven target.

news.title: Vijay Deverakonda's Pan-India Historical Epic Ranabaali Locks October Arrival
news.summary: Director Rahul Sankrityan's upcoming period action film Ranabaali, featuring Vijay Deverakonda, Rashmika, and Arnold Vosloo, has officially confirmed its worldwide theatrical release for October 16 to coincide with Vijayadashami. The makers released a fresh poster showcasing the lead actor as a warrior, putting an end to ongoing speculation surrounding the schedule.

news.title: Chiranjeevi and Bobby's Kaaka Commences Dubbing Ahead of Sankranthi Release
news.summary: Director Bobby and Megastar Chiranjeevi's upcoming collaboration Kaaka has officially started its dubbing phase with a traditional puja ceremony. Despite chatter about potential schedule changes, the team is working at a brisk pace to wrap up remaining production by November and secure a January 13, 2027 theatrical release.
